The instructions are not clear, and instructors always have something in mind when they are handing out the projects. This vision isn't about the basic design principles. Rather, they are more for the aesthetics. They want these projects in one way and one way only, when they aren't even giving enough instructions about these projects so it's a struggle to find what they want. Students are trying to fit in within these visions, which results in projects looking similar or nearly the same because, most of the time, it's what gets you decent grades. Most of the time, the works look like they were made by the same person(The collage project). And the thing I want to highlight the most is the insufficient reviews. Especially for the final projects, instructors are not helping at all. They don't help with idea development. They certainly don't help with the way how to do it. Most of the reviews that are given to me, or the ones that I heard, are absolutely not helpful. They are very superficial with the reviews. And I really want to highlight that students are not asking for them to do all the job; we simply want guidance to learn and develop ideas. But we are not really making any progress with the system we have now. Lastly the course is asking for a stop-motion animation for the final project despite not giving ANY lectures. For two whole semesters, we learned nothing about it, yet they expected us to do an amazing job at it. Basically, students are struggling because they have very weak guidance and projects that are really irrelevant to the course and the things that they learned.
